notes.title: Thank You - Patch Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the incredible support and feedback! It's been truly incredible and so much more than I could have ever expected. I'm out of town but upon my return home I'll begin working on a content patch for buried, as well as bug fixes. 

The patch will include:

 New puzzles need to escape. 
 New horror events. 
 A much more complete phone with much more lore and things to find. 
 Many bug fixes and balance adjustments. 


I am also looking to change the ending a bit and expand upon it, but I won't guarantee that for the next patch. 

Expecting the patch to be done within the next 2 weeks or less!

Thank you again!
- Authogin
